falsifiable_mechanism: Equivalent ordinary questions fail to preserve a requested relation and its arguments when proposing an existing proof operation; unsupported truth/execution and altered roles must never be normalized away. Source syntax/layout failures are measured separately.
acceptance: Verified source-supported gains in ordinary wording; no lost valid support, no new unsupported claims, preserved complete qualifications/citations and required software gates pass. Remaining coverage misses are reported and do not alone prohibit an incremental release.
source_renderings: Same statement lines: separate HTML paragraphs versus newline-preserving plain pre. Report separately; do not treat layout repeats as unique recovered questions.
